dataset: Drishti-GS1 (optic disc + optic cup segmentation, retinal fundus)
eval_note: 50 train + 51 test images. OC is the hard class (small, low contrast); OD is nearly saturated. Two comparison regimes: (a) semi-supervised on Drishti's own train set, (b) unsupervised domain adaptation (train on REFUGE/RIGA/RIM-ONE, test on Drishti with NO Drishti labels). Scores compiled from papers/abstracts - verify in source.

papers.name: DST-Net - Dual Self-integrated Transformer Network
papers.why_relevant: Recent, explicitly semi-supervised, evaluated on Drishti-GS1 - closest match to our setting.

papers.name: Joint optic disc and cup segmentation using semi-supervised conditional GANs

best_score.note: verify - approx Dice_OD ~0.96 / Dice_OC ~0.83 on Drishti

papers.name: BEAL - Boundary and Entropy-driven Adversarial Learning
papers.supervision: unsupervised domain adaptation (source labels only; 0 Drishti labels)

best_score.note: verify - approx Dice_OD ~0.96 / Dice_OC ~0.86 on Drishti target
